title: Surreal Desert Portal
description: A surreal stained-glass style composition features a glowing white circular portal with a red center and crosshair targeting a small white castle. The portal is cracked and emits lightning bolts. A cobblestone path winds through sand dunes from the bottom, passing a table with chairs, a small fence, and a rabbit on a pedestal. The scene is framed by white magnolia flowers and an arched top showing a deserted old-west town.
prompt: Surreal symbolic artwork in the style of stained glass, featuring a cracked glowing white circular portal with red core and sniper crosshair targeting a tiny white castle inside. Lightning bolts emanate from the portal. Below, a stone path winds through desert dunes toward the portal, with a small table and chairs, a fence, and a rabbit statue on a pedestal. The entire scene is framed by white magnolia flowers at the corners and top arch showing a deserted old western town under a black sky.
